title: Floor mats and rear floor hump
summary: Feedback on floor mats and the floor area covers mat color preference, mat retention issues, and dissatisfaction with the rear floor hump, with many examples lacking clear sentiment labeling.

positive.summary: Positive feedback praises the switch to black floor mats as a better choice.

negative.summary: Negative feedback reports difficulty securing the floor mat anchor and using the Velcro attachment.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention better mat position, weak Velcro that lets mats slide, and dislike of the rear floor hump, but the small set does not support a clearer sentiment split.

limitations: The topic mixes two related but distinct subjects: floor mat retention and the rear floor hump.
Most sampled examples are labeled undetermined, which limits sentiment interpretation.
The evidence is a small stratified sample and is not representative of all reviews.
